summary: SHIPPED 2026-05-13 (Phase 10). 89 algorithms across non-modifying / modifying / rearrangement / sort / binary search / partition + stable_partition / heap / set ops / min-max-clamp / comparison / permutation. Three external deferrals tracked in HEADER_SUBTITLES, not here: ranges:: overloads (await <ranges>'s tuple-dependent views), parallel-execution-policy overloads (await <execution>), lexicographical_compare_three_way (awaits <compare> Phase C6's FP total order).
C++20 layout-compat family (is_layout_compatible, is_pointer_interconvertible_base_of, is_pointer_interconvertible_with_class).
blockers: Compiler intrinsic-backed; needs __is_layout_compatible / __is_pointer_interconvertible_*. Add to detection-macro table.

summary: C++23 reference-from-temporary detection (reference_constructs_from_temporary, reference_converts_from_temporary).
move_if_noexcept. The single deferred utility. Trivially small — 8 lines.
Full <functional> implementation.

Mostly shipped (5 of 5 catalogued symbols). The C++98/03 path for the SBO + heap-fallback storage is the only outstanding work; the C++11+ path uses variadic templates + rvalue refs for the forwarding ctors and is functionally complete. Tracked in the <any> data sheet's failure_reason field.
blockers: Pre-C++11 implementation needs a hand-written tag-dispatched storage discriminant (SFINAE on traits available pre-C++11).

summary: optional<T> container itself, plus make_optional, comparisons, swap, hash specialisation. Tag types and exception have already shipped.
variant<Ts...>, monostate, bad_variant_access, visit, holds_alternative, get<I>/get<T>, variant_size, variant_alternative.
blockers: Heaviest unimplemented module; requires careful constexpr work.

summary: expected<T,E>, unexpected<E>, bad_expected_access, in_place_t / unexpect_t tags. C++23.
Full tuple implementation. operator<=> blocked on restd::compare; allocator-aware ctors blocked on restd::memory.
blockers: restd::compare (memory now satisfied), restd::reference_wrapper, restd::utility integer_sequence

summary: Phase C6 — the only remaining work after Phases C1-C5 shipped 2026-05-17 (all 17 catalogued symbols delivered). C6 covers the floating-point special case in the strong_order / weak_order niebloids: per [cmp.alg], for `float`, `double`, `long double` inputs the niebloid must produce a deterministic total order even across NaN (treating NaN as ordered relative to all finite values, distinguishing +NaN from -NaN, distinguishing -0 from +0). The standard's algorithm operates on the bit pattern; implementations typically use bit_cast (C++20+) or memcpy. Deferred because the rest of the module is functionally complete without it — FP inputs currently route through path (c) of the niebloid and return their built-in partial_ordering, which fails to convert to strong/weak ordering for NaN (compile or runtime mismatch).
blockers: Per-platform IEEE-754 sign-and-bit-pattern manipulation, ideally via restd::bit_cast (not yet shipped) or std::memcpy.

summary: array<T,N> with the C++14 constexpr surface and C++17 deduction guides.
basic_string_view + char_traits enough to support it.
span<T,N>. Trivially constexpr.

Phase 7c follow-ups: iter_concept pull-through in iterator_traits primary; istream_iterator / ostream_iterator / istreambuf_iterator / ostreambuf_iterator (need <iostream>); common_iterator and counted_iterator (need <ranges>).
blockers: <iostream> for stream iterators; <ranges> for the C++20 adaptors.

summary: Phase 6d follow-ups: aligned-new for over-aligned types in make_shared<T[]>; atomic shared_ptr ops + std::atomic<shared_ptr<T>>; hash<shared_ptr>/hash<unique_ptr>; MSVC atomic refcount path; shared_ptr<T[N]> <-> shared_ptr<U[N]> qualification-only conversions.
blockers: <atomic> for atomic shared_ptr; <functional> hash for the hash specs.

summary: Floating-point midpoint(double,...) — needs careful inf/NaN/rounding handling; parallel-execution-policy overloads (need <execution>); C++26 saturation arithmetic (add_sat, sub_sat, mul_sat, div_sat, saturate_cast).
blockers: <execution> for parallel; focused phase for sat arith.

summary: Phase R30+ — remaining work after Phases R1-R29 shipped 2026-05-13. Every remaining catalogued <ranges> symbol is blocked on an external module being unfinished: range_common_reference_t (needs full common_reference chain — basic common_reference is shipped, but the chain handling needs completion); basic_istream_view (needs restd::<iostream>); common_view (blocked on common_iterator from iterator Phase 7c); the seven tuple-dependent C++23 views — elements_view / keys_view / values_view, enumerate_view, zip_view, zip_transform_view, adjacent_view, adjacent_transform_view, cartesian_product_view (all need restd::<tuple>); concat_view (C++26, needs restd::<variant>); generator (needs restd::<coroutine>); ranges::to (needs concepts + concrete container types — e.g. restd::vector). No <ranges>-internal work remains.
blockers: <concepts> syntax for the proper concept-form versions; <tuple> for the 7 tuple-dependent views; <variant> for concat_view; <coroutine> for generator; <iostream> for basic_istream_view; concrete container types for ranges::to; common_iterator from <iterator> for common_view; full common_reference for range_common_reference_t.

summary: Placement new, std::nothrow, bad_alloc / bad_array_new_length, hardware_destructive_interference_size / hardware_constructive_interference_size (C++17), launder (C++17), align_val_t + over-aligned new (C++17). Foundational — many other modules need at least bad_alloc.
blockers: Some are compiler-magic (launder, hardware_*_interference_size). Bad_alloc inheritance from <exception>.

summary: exception base class, exception_ptr, current_exception / rethrow_exception, make_exception_ptr, throw_with_nested, rethrow_if_nested, nested_exception, terminate / set_terminate / get_terminate, uncaught_exception(s). Foundational — almost every module's exception-throwing path needs this.
blockers: exception_ptr is opaque, needs platform-specific support; nested_exception needs RTTI.

summary: logic_error, runtime_error, and their concrete derivatives (domain_error, invalid_argument, length_error, out_of_range, range_error, overflow_error, underflow_error). All public-inheritance from std::exception. Tiny but pervasive.
type_info, bad_cast, bad_typeid. Needs RTTI; std::type_info::operator== and ::name() are core. Anchor for <typeindex>, <any>, dynamic_cast.
blockers: RTTI must be enabled (-fno-rtti would gate this out); type_info::operator== requires platform-specific name interning.

summary: type_index — a wrapper around type_info* providing operator< and hash<type_index>. Tiny once <typeinfo> is in place.

error_code, error_condition, error_category, errc enum, system_error exception, generic_category / system_category, make_error_code / make_error_condition. Foundational for <filesystem>, <future>, <thread>, networking.
blockers: Platform errno-table mapping for system_category; <exception> for system_error base.

summary: initializer_list<E>. Compiler-magic: the type the compiler binds to braced-init-list expressions. Trivial wrapper class with begin/end/size; the magic is in the compiler.
blockers: Compiler support for the brace-init-list -> initializer_list deduction (C++11+).

summary: numeric_limits<T> with per-type specializations for every fundamental arithmetic type. Many member values are intrinsics-friendly (__FLT_MAX__, etc). Foundational for <chrono>, <random>, <bitset>, and arithmetic templates.
blockers: Per-platform intrinsic constants (could use std:: as canonical for non-strict mode).

summary: Feature-test macros only — no symbols. Pure macro file expanding to __cpp_lib_* values. Probably mostly a generated artifact from restd's detection-macro table.

source_location class with file_name / function_name / line / column accessors and the consteval factory current(). Needs __builtin_source_location (GCC) or __builtin_FILE / __builtin_LINE / __builtin_COLUMN / __builtin_FUNCTION (Clang).

Foundational concept library: same_as, derived_from, convertible_to, common_reference_with, common_with, integral, floating_point, signed_integral, unsigned_integral, assignable_from, swappable, destructible, constructible_from, default_initializable, move_constructible, copy_constructible, equality_comparable(_with), totally_ordered(_with), movable, copyable, semiregular, regular, invocable, regular_invocable, predicate, relation, equivalence_relation, strict_weak_order.
blockers: C++20 concept syntax for true concept-form versions; pre-C++20 back-port as SFINAE traits is feasible (restd already has the foundations in <type_traits>).

summary: coroutine_traits, coroutine_handle, noop_coroutine, suspend_never, suspend_always. Compiler-magic — depends on the coroutine state machine the compiler generates around co_await / co_yield / co_return.
blockers: Compiler must support C++20 coroutines (-fcoroutines on GCC, /await on MSVC). The library half is small; the language half is the constraint.

summary: bit_cast (C++20), byteswap (C++23), has_single_bit, bit_ceil, bit_floor, bit_width, rotl, rotr, countl_zero / countl_one / countr_zero / countr_one, popcount, endian enum. Many map to compiler intrinsics (__builtin_*).
blockers: Compiler intrinsics (__builtin_clz/ctz/popcount); bit_cast needs is_trivially_copyable and memcpy-style reinterpret.

summary: Mathematical constants: e_v, log2e_v, log10e_v, pi_v, inv_pi_v, inv_sqrtpi_v, ln2_v, ln10_v, sqrt2_v, sqrt3_v, inv_sqrt3_v, egamma_v, phi_v plus the implicit-double aliases. Trivial constexpr template variables.
ratio<N,D>, ratio_add / subtract / multiply / divide, ratio_equal / not_equal / less / less_equal / greater / greater_equal, SI prefix typedefs (atto..exa). Foundational for <chrono>.
bitset<N>, all bitwise ops, to_ulong / to_ullong / to_string, count, size, test, all/any/none, set / reset / flip, hash<bitset>. Medium-sized but mechanically simple.

summary: stacktrace_entry, basic_stacktrace, stacktrace = basic_stacktrace<allocator<stacktrace_entry>>. C++23. Heavily platform-dependent — needs DWARF/PDB symbolisation or the libbacktrace / libunwind path.

summary: duration, time_point, system_clock / steady_clock / high_resolution_clock; C++20 calendar (year_month_day, weekday, last_spec, etc.); time zones (zoned_time, tzdb_list, get_tzdb); duration_cast / time_point_cast; formatter specialisations; literals (1s, 1ms, etc.). Large.

blockers: <cmath> for the transcendentals; <iostream> for stream operators (which can be deferred).

summary: Engines (linear_congruential_engine, mersenne_twister_engine, subtract_with_carry_engine, the named typedefs mt19937 etc., random_device); adaptors (discard_block_engine, independent_bits_engine, shuffle_order_engine); distributions (uniform_int/real, bernoulli, binomial, geometric, negative_binomial, poisson, exponential, gamma, weibull, extreme_value, normal, lognormal, chi_squared, cauchy, fisher_f, student_t, discrete, piecewise_constant, piecewise_linear); seed_seq, generate_canonical. summary: valarray<T>, slice / gslice, slice_array / gslice_array / mask_array / indirect_array, transcendentals on valarrays. Specialised; rarely used but still in the standard.

basic_string<CharT, Traits, Allocator>, the four char specialisations (string / wstring / u8string (C++20) / u16string / u32string), char_traits<CharT> per-char-type, std::stoX number parsers, std::to_string, the C++17 std::string_view interop, operator+ overloads, hash<string>. Large core component.
blockers: <memory> for allocator; <iterator>; <functional> hash for the hash specs; <limits>.

summary: to_chars / from_chars + chars_format enum. C++17 fast numeric ↔ string conversion (locale-independent). Performance-critical; the integer paths are simple but the FP paths (Ryu / Dragonbox) are substantial.

format / format_to / format_to_n / formatted_size / vformat, format_string, format_args, basic_format_arg, basic_format_context, formatter<T> per-type specs (arithmetic / strings / chrono / ranges / pointers / etc.). Large. Anchor for <print> and <chrono> formatters.

Extended floating-point types: float16_t, float32_t, float64_t, float128_t, bfloat16_t. C++23. Some require compiler / ABI support and may be conditionally absent (_Float16, __bf16, etc.).

vector<T, Alloc> + vector<bool> specialisation, hash<vector<bool>>, comparisons (incl. operator<=>), erase / erase_if free functions. Anchor container — many other modules implicitly need it (e.g. ranges::to default target).
deque<T, Alloc>, comparisons, erase / erase_if. Block-of-blocks layout — implementation is more involved than vector.
list<T, Alloc>, comparisons, erase / erase_if. Doubly-linked list, splice / merge / sort / unique / remove / remove_if / reverse.
forward_list<T, Alloc>, comparisons, erase / erase_if. Singly-linked list (C++11).
stack<T, Container=deque<T>> container adaptor. Trivial wrapper.
queue<T, Container=deque<T>>, priority_queue<T, Container=vector<T>, Compare=less<T>>. Container adaptors.
blockers: <deque>, <vector>, <functional> (for less and the heap algorithms — already in <algorithm>).

summary: map<Key, T, Compare, Alloc> + multimap. Red-black-tree based. Insertion / lookup / range erase / structured-binding-friendly iterators (key, value pair).
set<Key, Compare, Alloc> + multiset. Same tree backbone as <map> but key-only.
unordered_map<Key, T, Hash, KeyEqual, Alloc> + unordered_multimap. Hash-table based.
blockers: <memory>, <iterator>, <utility> for pair, <functional> for hash and equal_to.

summary: unordered_set<Key, Hash, KeyEqual, Alloc> + unordered_multiset.
flat_map<Key, T, Compare, KeyContainer, MappedContainer> + flat_multimap. C++23 — sorted-vector-of-pairs adaptor; cache-friendly alternative to <map>.
flat_set<Key, Compare, KeyContainer> + flat_multiset. C++23 — sorted-vector adaptor; cache-friendly alternative to <set>.
mdspan<T, Extents, LayoutPolicy, AccessorPolicy>, extents, dextents, layout_left / layout_right / layout_stride, default_accessor. C++23 multi-dimensional non-owning view.
inplace_vector<T, N>. C++26 fixed-capacity vector with inline storage. Smaller surface than <vector> but with C++26's deducing-this and constexpr support.
hive<T, Alloc>. C++26 (formerly colony). Bucketed container with stable iterators across insertion / erasure. New design.

std::locale, facet ABC, the named facets (collate, ctype, codecvt, numpunct, num_get/put, money_get/put, time_get/put, messages, money_punct), use_facet / has_facet. Locale-aware character conversion + numeric / time formatting. Large.

summary: codecvt_utf8 / codecvt_utf16 / codecvt_utf8_utf16 specialisations + codecvt_mode. DEPRECATED in C++17, REMOVED in C++26. Implement only for backward compat if at all.

basic_regex<CharT, Traits>, regex / wregex typedefs, regex_match / regex_search / regex_replace / regex_iterator / regex_token_iterator, match_results / sub_match, regex_constants, regex_error, the regex_traits<CharT> trait. Significant — the parser + NFA/DFA engine is the bulk of the work.

filesystem::path, directory_entry, directory_iterator / recursive_directory_iterator, file_status, perms, file_type, the filesystem free functions (canonical, absolute, copy / copy_file, create_directory, current_path, exists, file_size, hard_link_count, is_*, last_write_time, permissions, read_symlink, remove / remove_all, rename, resize_file, space, status, symlink_status, temp_directory_path, weakly_canonical), filesystem_error.
Forward declarations for the iostream subsystem. Tiny — just the templated typedef chain that lets you forward-declare std::ostream et al without dragging in <iostream>.
ios_base, basic_ios, fmtflags / iostate / openmode / seekdir / streamoff / streampos, manipulators (boolalpha, showpoint, etc.). Foundational for the whole I/O subsystem.
basic_streambuf<CharT, Traits>. The buffer ABC that every iostream sits on. Virtual interface; concrete derived buffers live in <fstream>, <sstream>, <syncstream>, <spanstream>.
basic_istream<CharT, Traits>, basic_iostream<CharT, Traits>, operator>> overloads for the arithmetic types and std::string, ws / getline manipulators.
basic_ostream<CharT, Traits>, operator<< overloads for the arithmetic types and std::string, endl / ends / flush / emit_on_flush / noemit_on_flush / flush_emit manipulators.
The global standard streams: cin / cout / cerr / clog and their wide cousins. Static-init order is delicate (the Schwarz counter pattern).
blockers: <istream>, <ostream>; freestanding-mode behaviour needs platform glue (write(2) / WriteFile).

summary: basic_filebuf, basic_ifstream / basic_ofstream / basic_fstream. The disk-backed stream family.
basic_stringbuf, basic_istringstream / basic_ostringstream / basic_stringstream. String-backed streams; common for parsing and formatting.

Parametric manipulators: setbase, setfill, setprecision, setw, setiosflags, resetiosflags, get_time / put_time, get_money / put_money, quoted (C++14). Tiny — each manipulator is a small expression-template.
basic_osyncstream / basic_syncbuf. C++20 — wraps an underlying stream and atomically emits on destruction. Synchronises concurrent writes.
basic_spanstream and basic_spanbuf. C++23 — span-backed stream (alternative to stringstream for fixed-buffer use cases).
std::print / std::println / std::vprint_unicode / std::vprint_nonunicode. C++23 — std::format-based formatted I/O, the closest std equivalent to printf.
blockers: <format>; platform Unicode-stdout detection (IsConsole + GetConsoleMode on Windows).

summary: strstream / istrstream / ostrstream / strstreambuf. DEPRECATED since C++98 — superseded by <sstream>. Include only for backwards compat.

std::atomic<T> + std::atomic_flag, the full operation surface (load / store / exchange / compare_exchange_weak/strong / fetch_add/sub/and/or/xor / wait/notify_one/notify_all (C++20)), memory_order enum, atomic_ref<T> (C++20), atomic<shared_ptr<T>> + atomic<weak_ptr<T>> (C++20). Anchor for lock-free programming and the <memory> Phase 6d follow-ups.
blockers: Compiler intrinsics (__atomic_* / __c11_atomic_* / std::atomic builtins); platform memory model.

summary: std::thread, std::jthread (C++20), this_thread:: namespace (get_id / sleep_for / sleep_until / yield), thread::id and its hash, hardware_concurrency. Foundational for the rest of concurrency.
blockers: Platform thread creation (pthread / Win32); <stop_token> for jthread; <chrono> for sleep_*.

summary: mutex / recursive_mutex / timed_mutex / recursive_timed_mutex, lock_guard / unique_lock / scoped_lock (C++17), once_flag / call_once, try_lock, std::lock (variadic). Pervasive.
blockers: Platform mutex (pthread_mutex_t / CRITICAL_SECTION); <chrono> for the timed variants.

summary: shared_mutex (C++17), shared_timed_mutex (C++14), shared_lock. Reader-writer locking.
condition_variable, condition_variable_any, cv_status enum, notify_all_at_thread_exit. The wait/notify primitive for thread coordination.
future / shared_future / promise / packaged_task, async, launch enum, future_status / future_error / future_errc / future_category. Asynchronous result delivery.
counting_semaphore<LeastMaxValue> + binary_semaphore alias. C++20 acquire / release / try_acquire / try_acquire_for / try_acquire_until.
blockers: <atomic> for the counter; <chrono> for the timed variants.

summary: std::latch. C++20 single-use down-counter — count_down / wait / try_wait / arrive_and_wait.
std::barrier<CompletionFunction>. C++20 reusable barrier — arrive / wait / arrive_and_wait / arrive_and_drop, with an optional completion phase.
stop_token / stop_source / stop_callback / nostopstate_t. Cooperative cancellation primitive. Anchors jthread's stop API.

execution policies (sequenced_policy, parallel_policy, parallel_unsequenced_policy, unsequenced_policy + the seq / par / par_unseq / unseq instances). The hook for parallel-algorithm overloads in <algorithm> and <numeric>.
blockers: Platform thread pool / TBB / OpenMP integration for the par_* policies.

summary: hazard_pointer / hazard_pointer_obj_base. C++26 lock-free reclamation primitive.
rcu_obj_base / rcu_domain. C++26 read-copy-update synchronisation primitive.
std::generator<Ref, V, Allocator>. C++23 coroutine-based input range view. Anchor for the deferred <ranges>::generator dependency.

C++26 std::linalg namespace — BLAS-style dense linear algebra (matrix_*, vector_*, the operation tags + the free functions add / scale / scaled / conjugated / transposed / hermitian_transposed / etc.). Layered on <mdspan>.
is_debugger_present, breakpoint, breakpoint_if_debugging. C++26 debugger interaction primitives.
std::text_encoding. C++26 identification of named character encodings (mostly IANA names).
blockers: <string_view>; embedded encoding registry (could share data with <format>'s Unicode width tables).

summary: assert macro. Toggles on NDEBUG. Trivial passthrough to the C <assert.h>.

isalnum / isalpha / isblank / iscntrl / isdigit / isgraph / islower / isprint / ispunct / isspace / isupper / isxdigit / tolower / toupper. Locale-affected in C but always-C-locale in restd unless wired through <locale>.

fenv_t, fexcept_t, feclearexcept / fegetexceptflag / feraiseexcept / fesetexceptflag / fetestexcept, fegetround / fesetround, fegetenv / fesetenv / feholdexcept / feupdateenv. FP environment access.

PRI* / SCN* printf/scanf format macros, imaxabs / imaxdiv / strtoimax / strtoumax / wcstoimax / wcstoumax. Pure passthrough to <inttypes.h>.
CHAR_BIT / SCHAR_MIN / SCHAR_MAX / CHAR_MIN / CHAR_MAX / SHRT_* / INT_* / LONG_* / LLONG_* / MB_LEN_MAX. Pure passthrough to <limits.h>.
locale-related — setlocale, localeconv, lconv struct, LC_* category macros. Passthrough to <locale.h>. Distinct from <locale>.

abs / fabs / fmod / remainder / remquo / fma / fmin / fmax / fdim / nan / exp / exp2 / expm1 / log / log10 / log2 / log1p / pow / sqrt / cbrt / hypot / sin / cos / tan / asin / acos / atan / atan2 / sinh / cosh / tanh / asinh / acosh / atanh / erf / erfc / lgamma / tgamma / ceil / floor / trunc / round / lround / llround / nearbyint / rint / lrint / llrint / frexp / ldexp / modf / scalbn / scalbln / ilogb / logb / nextafter / nexttoward / copysign / FP classification (fpclassify / isfinite / isinf / isnan / isnormal / signbit) / FP comparison (isgreater / isgreaterequal / isless / islessequal / islessgreater / isunordered). Pure passthrough but enormous surface.
jmp_buf, setjmp / longjmp. Pure passthrough — discouraged in C++ (skips destructors).
sig_atomic_t, SIG_* macros, signal / raise. Pure passthrough.
va_list / va_start / va_arg / va_end / va_copy. Pure passthrough.
size_t, ptrdiff_t, max_align_t (C++11), nullptr_t (C++11), byte (C++17), offsetof macro, NULL macro. Foundational — many other modules need at least size_t / ptrdiff_t / nullptr_t.

intN_t / uintN_t / int_fastN_t / uint_fastN_t / int_leastN_t / uint_leastN_t (N = 8/16/32/64), intmax_t / uintmax_t, intptr_t / uintptr_t, INT*_MIN/MAX, INTMAX_MIN/MAX, INTPTR_MIN/MAX, PTRDIFF_MIN/MAX, SIZE_MAX, WCHAR_MIN/MAX, WINT_MIN/MAX, INT*_C / UINT*_C macros.

FILE, fpos_t, EOF / NULL / BUFSIZ / FILENAME_MAX / FOPEN_MAX / L_tmpnam / TMP_MAX, stdin/stdout/stderr, fopen / freopen / fclose / fflush / setbuf / setvbuf, fread / fwrite, fgetc / fputc / fgets / fputs / fgetpos / fsetpos / fseek / ftell / rewind / ferror / feof / clearerr / perror, printf family, scanf family, remove / rename / tmpfile / tmpnam. Pure passthrough.

atof / atoi / atol / atoll / strtod / strtof / strtol / strtoll / strtold / strtoul / strtoull, rand / srand / RAND_MAX, malloc / free / calloc / realloc / aligned_alloc (C++17), abort / atexit / at_quick_exit / exit / quick_exit / _Exit / EXIT_SUCCESS / EXIT_FAILURE, getenv, system, qsort / bsearch, abs / labs / llabs / div / ldiv / lldiv, mblen / mbtowc / wctomb / mbstowcs / wcstombs, MB_CUR_MAX.

memchr / memcmp / memcpy / memmove / memset, strcpy / strncpy / strcat / strncat / strcmp / strncmp / strchr / strrchr / strspn / strcspn / strpbrk / strstr / strtok / strlen, strcoll / strxfrm, strerror, NULL. Pure passthrough.
clock_t, time_t, tm struct, timespec (C++17), CLOCKS_PER_SEC, clock / time / difftime / mktime / asctime / ctime / gmtime / localtime / strftime / timespec_get (C++17). Pure passthrough.
char16_t / char32_t (C++11), mbrtoc16 / c16rtomb / mbrtoc32 / c32rtomb. Multi-byte to char16_t/char32_t conversion.

wchar_t, wint_t, mbstate_t, WCHAR_MIN/MAX, WEOF, the wide-char string functions (wcscpy / wcsncpy / wcscat / etc.), the wide stdio (fwide / fgetwc / fputwc / fgetws / fputws / fwprintf / fwscanf / etc.), wcstod / wcstof / wcstold / wcstol / wcstoll / wcstoul / wcstoull, mbsinit / btowc / wctob / mbrlen / mbrtowc / wcrtomb / mbsrtowcs / wcsrtombs.
